Eric: RCA posted for the billing ingestion lag — link: <https://redwood.internal/rca/1769600000-billing-ingest-lag|rca/billing-ingest-lag> :link:
Nina: thanks. TL;DR for execs? need 1-2 bullets for billing slide.
Eric: TL;DR: a change to the ingestion pipeline's batching window caused delayed invoice record commits to the billing datastore; roughly 0.7% of billing events were delayed by 20-45 minutes between 2026-04-24 03:10-03:55 UTC. No incorrect charges; delays only.
Priya: added timeline + ingestion queue depth graphs to doc (section 2).
Katie: Finance flagged a few customers who saw late invoices; no revenue impact but visibility issues. drafting proactive note.
Eric: root cause: we reduced the commit frequency to improve DB write throughput but missed a boundary case where small-volume accounts were batched indefinitely when no trigger arrived.
Nina: action items (owner / due):
- restore commit fallback for low-volume buckets (owner: Priya) — due 2026-04-25
- add alert for "billing-ingest-delay" if >5m median for 10m (owner: Eric) — due 2026-04-26
- customer comms template and ops FAQ (owner: Katie) — due 2026-04-25
- postmortem doc update with runbook steps for manual flush (owner: Priya) — due 2026-04-24
Priya: PR up to add fallback flush; testing in staging now.
FinanceBot: RCA PDF uploaded to GDrive and incident tracker — <https://drive.redwood/RCAs/1769600000-billing-ingest.pdf>
Eric: follow-up checkpoint: 2026-04-28 14:00 UTC (20m) — invite sent. agenda: PR verification, alerting, customer outreach status.
Jenna: pls include a one-liner for all-hands: "Minor delays in billing ingestion for a small fraction of accounts due to batching change; fixes and outreach underway." I'll add it.
Katie: posting draft customer note to #customer-success for review.
Eric: thanks all — ping me if anything missing. closing thread after checkpoint.
